newsitem.title: USA: CSCE coffee jumps sharply ahead of the close.
newsitem.headline: CSCE coffee jumps sharply ahead of the close.

text.p: CSCE coffee futures rose sharply Wednesday afternoon, bolstered by a late-session rush of trade and speculative buying, dealers said.

September arabicas surged to a session high of 184.50 cents per lb, but eased to 182.50 cents in the last few minutes of trading, up 13.40. December was up 6.25 to 158.00, while the rest were 1.10 to 4.00 higher.
Traders said upward accelerated after September broke through key chart resistance at 178.00 cents, triggering buy-stops.
Fundamentally, they said the market's continued fears of a shortage of exchange-certified coffee for delivery against front-month September fueled the rally.
